label: MAXIME_ENS_1: The maximum in being: IsMaximalIn InAct MoreIn esse m, that is, m has being and…
definition: The maximum in being: `IsMaximalIn InAct MoreIn esse m`, that is, m has being and nothing is more a being than m. Reached in the quarta via from the maximally true (quae sunt maxime vera, sunt maxime entia). Uniqueness is not part of the definition; it is the derived statement STMT-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING.
note: Lean locator uses the canonical IsMaximalIn spelling. Its body unfolds to the existing IsMaximumIn compatibility definition, InAct m r ∧ ∀ y, ¬ MoreIn r y m. This is the same merely-maximal predicate, not greatest degree, strict supremacy or an independently established existence claim. Audit correction: the frozen unique-root types use IsMaximumIn itself. The locator names that predicate body directly; IsMaximalIn is its compatibility alias. No stronger order or distinct mathematical sense is introduced by either spelling.
